## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria map to evidence.
- [ ] One active writer owned this checkout.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Evidence identifies the exact source/artifact and distinguishes
      self-check from independent verification.
- [ ] Failure and recovery behavior were exercised.
- [ ] Migration, rollback, and cross-platform impact are covered or marked not
      applicable with a reason.
- [ ] CSP and Tauri capabilities remain narrow.
- [ ] No unbounded queue, list, scan, or transcript was introduced.
- [ ] Dependency and package impact is documented.
- [ ] Fresh-context independent review and independent verification are
      requested.
